description: This Java class 'XmlSerializer' provides methods for serializing and deserializing Java objects to and from XML, including support for standard Java types, collections, maps, and custom serializable objects. It is marked as deprecated, with a recommendation to use 'UtilXml.java' for marshalling/unmarshalling.

classes.name: XmlSerializer
classes.description: A deprecated Java class for serializing and deserializing Java objects to XML format, supporting various data types, collections, maps, and custom objects.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a Java object into an XML string.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a Java object from an XML string, with optional delegator context.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a Java object from a DOM Document, with delegator context.

methods.name: serializeSingle
methods.description: Converts a Java object into an XML Element.

methods.name: serializeCustom
methods.description: Serializes a custom Serializable object into XML.

methods.name: makeElement
methods.description: Creates an XML Element with a given name and value.

methods.name: deserializeSingle
methods.description: Converts an XML Element back into a Java object.

methods.name: deserializeCustom
methods.description: Deserializes a custom object from an XML Element.

methods.name: getDateFormat
methods.description: Provides a DateFormat instance for serializing/deserializing java.util.Date objects.
